what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Egypt, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2881 Iraqi refugees in Egypt, 1.1% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1987 to 2025, with IS, al-Mahdi Army and Ansar al-Islam among the opponents since 2004.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in some years up to 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 50 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 10273, at the end of 2007; the main years of displacement in the data are 2007 to 2014.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Egypt.
These are year-end totals for Egypt only, reported to UNHCR.
